rationale: Explicit primary rule requires strict greater-than against earlier values and at least every later value. Bind the conventional >= reading of at least. Dynamic nonfinite states are discussed without an admission exclusion, so guard True. Classical fallback is separate and does not repair the marked-state relation.

interpretations.meaning: Earlier strict-greater and later nonstrict-greater comparisons.
interpretations.expression: all(values[i] > values[j] for j in indices if j < i) and all(values[i] >= values[k] for k in indices if k > i)
